title: Different Sensitivity
text: Roots and shoots have different sensitivities to auxin. The same concentration that promotes growth in shoots can inhibit growth in roots. Roots are much more sensitive to auxin.

title: Opposite Effects
text: In stems: high auxin = faster growth (elongation). In roots: high auxin = slower growth (inhibition). This explains why auxin accumulation on the lower side causes shoots to bend up but roots to bend down.
